content:
Retry the previous planning task: Write SPEC.md and PLAN.md (in pt-BR) for a complete DOOM-style retro FPS clone in project dir "/mnt/dados/projetos/doom test" (path has a space — quote it). Plan only, do not implement.

Requirements (non-negotiable): Three.js + vanilla ES modules + HTML5 + CSS, static-serve (no build), zero external assets (procedural canvas textures + WebAudio), lightweight (no shadows, low draw calls). FOUR weapons (fists, pistol hitscan, shotgun spread hitscan, rocket launcher splash). SIX enemies (imp fire projectile, zombie hitscan, demon melee, baron tank double projectile, cacodemon floating projectile, revenant rocket) each with FSM AI idle/alert/chase/attack/pain/death + grid DDA line-of-sight. Minimap canvas overlay (walls, doors, pickups, enemies red dots, player arrow + view cone). EXTREMELY detailed low-cost physics: gravity, jump, Quake-style accel/friction (wishdir), AABB per-axis grid collision, knockback, splash falloff, camera bob, fixed-step updates. Grid map ~36x44, 6 color-coded zones, doors, pickups (health/armor/ammo), secrets, exit, lava damage, torches with PointLight. FSM MENU→PLAYING→PAUSED→GAME_OVER/WIN. Retro Doom HUD (dark panel, red/green bars, monospace, crosshair). Unit tests via node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" for pure logic (move/map/constants, TDD, 80% coverage) + final Playwright R29 verification (playwright-core, executablePath /usr/bin/chromium).

Lessons from cycle 1 to encode: R_y(+yaw) not R_y(-yaw) (mirror bug); C.RENDER must be complete (fogNear 25, fogFar 95, background 0x12121c); HemisphereLight(0x8899bb,0x445566,0.9)+torch PointLights; spawn in open hall center; FSM compare id.toUpperCase()===state with WHY comment; map builder paints borders '#' so never place symbols on border cells, normalize rows padEnd(44).slice(0,44), validate normalized map; favicon data:,; readPixels without preserveDrawingBuffer fakes black — use renderer.info.render.calls>0 + PIL pixel analysis; node --test tests/ fails (use glob); EXECUTION FRAGMENTATION (R22): executor window ~27k tokens, split into small waves (1-3 files each, fresh subagent per wave): W1 scaffold+constants+utils+engine+input+index.html+css+vendor three; W2 map.js+move.js+tests; W3 player.js+weapons.js; W4 enemies.js; W5 particles+audio+minimap; W6 hud+game.js+main.js; W7 full tests+node --check+fixes; W8 Playwright R29+polish. Three.js as LOCAL vendor copy (npm i three, copy three.module.js), no CDN, pinned version. Design skills per wave: W1 threejs-game-harness/threejs-gameplay-systems, W6 threejs-game-harness/threejs-game-ui-designer, W8 threejs-game-harness/threejs-qa-release. File layout: index.html, css/style.css, vendor/three.module.js, js/{constants,utils,engine,input,map,move,player,weapons,enemies,particles,audio,hud,minimap,game,main}.js, tests/*.test.mjs. Small files 200-400 LOC.

PLAN.md: per-wave tasks with verifiable acceptance criteria, dependencies, verification loop (node --check per wave, tests W2/W7, Playwright W8). SPEC.md: scope, design contract (weapons table damage/rate/ammo, enemies table HP/damage/speed/behavior), physics constants table, map layout, FSM, acceptance criteria mapped to user request. Both < 300 lines, concise. Return paths of files written.
